question.text: Which of the following statements regarding Lanthanides is false?

options.text: All lanthanides are solid at room temperature
They can be separated from one another by ion-exchange method
Ionic radii of trivalent lanthanides steadily increases with increase in atomic number

solution.text: The option (d) is false as lonic radi of trivalent lanthanides decreases with increase in atomic number due to lanthanoid contraction.
